scope: General-model research on the delivered dataset_v1; not personalized or deployed

target.name: y_next_any
target.long_component: Total duration of a valid session intersecting the next window; may extend beyond that window

protocol.inner: 20% of development users via GroupShuffleSplit, random_state=42
protocol.selection: Maximum validation F1 jointly over bounded configurations and decision grid; config ties prefer first, cutoff ties higher
protocol.proxy_cutoffs: Fixed source v1 definition; not learned or optimized on this test
protocol.feature_selection: Manual common seven-feature set; no performance-driven selection or ablation
protocol.class_weighting: RF balanced on fitting labels; LR unweighted; XGBoost scale_pos_weight=1; decision cutoff selected separately

metric_definitions.mean: Unweighted mean over outer folds, separately for training/validation/test
metric_definitions.pr_auc_ap: Average precision, not trapezoidal PR integration
metric_definitions.false_alert_day: FP / unique evaluated participant and source-local prediction-date pairs, including partial dates; not actual notifications
metric_definitions.validation: Used for selection; optimistic, not an independent performance estimate
metric_definitions.training: In-sample fit diagnostics; not generalization performance

limitations: New data/labels/eligibility/features differ from previous research. Old-versus-new scores do not isolate model improvement.
Long-session labels depend on full session length and retrospective <=3-hour acceptance; the outcome is not strictly confined to the next 30 minutes.
Eligibility and heartbeat coverage are retrospective cohort/quality decisions, not proof of live availability.
Local clock uses static participant timezone + one hour, not a verified timezone/DST history.
The original cohort has already been explored; outer folds are held out within this run, not a new external cohort.
No user-feedback target, personal-history adaptation, calibration, SHAP or Android validation in this experiment.
The source persistence lab_any baseline uses retrospective labels and is not a causal deployable competitor.

independent_source_check.scope: Independent five-user reproduction and sampled truncation check; not all participants or every edge case
